subject: Request for CXO sign-off: temporary pilot uplift + 90-day sandbox extension
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for CXO sign-off: temporary pilot uplift + 90-day sandbox extension

Team —

Quick ask: Edgewell AI (contact: Sanjay Verma) is stuck on the last integration sprint. They hit a blocker that prevents end-to-end evaluation of our streaming runtime; the SRE team on their side needs another 90 days in a private sandbox to finish the KV cache work. Without that, the PoC won't exercise our tail-latency optimizations and they’re unlikely to convert.

What they’re requesting: a nonstandard one-time uplift of 125k free token credits (hosted) plus a 90-day sandbox extension on top of the standard PLG limits. Procurement wants this in writing before they push the SOW. HubSpot: 3456; current pipeline value (best case) $420k ARR.

Why escalate: this exceeds the PLG credit policy and the normal 30-day sandbox window. I negotiated the SOW terms down, and they’re willing to sign a short addendum with (a) a success review at day 45 and (b) a matching commit if they see the metrics. We need CXO sign-off or explicit exception from Deal Desk to proceed.

Attachments: mutual action plan and draft SOW attached. I’ve also added the proposed addendum language in the MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (tab: extension).

Requested next step: can someone authorize temporary uplift + extension, or advise an alternate path (e.g., partial uplift + milestone-based release)? Need an answer by COB Monday (10/19) to keep momentum.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Verma <sanjay@edgewell.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for CXO sign-off: temporary pilot uplift + 90-day sandbox extension

Dev —

Appreciate the quick work on this. To be explicit: our integration team needs the KV cache behavior tested under production-like load; we cannot reproduce the failure in a 30-day window because our internal change calendar means the rollout will only be ready in ~75 days. Procurement will not approve the SOW without either (1) a 90-day private sandbox window or (2) proof of equivalent compute credit and environment access.

We are prepared to commit to a short-term purchase contingent on the test outcomes (I can sign a letter of intent). If Redwood can extend the sandbox and provide the 125k credits up front we will prioritize this deployment and aim for a Q1 prod rollout.

Sanjay
Head of Platform Engineering
Edgewell AI

Dev / Grace —

Thanks for the context. A few data points I need before I can put this to Laura:
- Estimated consumption profile for the 125k credits (tokens/day, peak TPS). Please include rough cost delta vs standard PLG allowances.
- What’s the explicit conversion trigger? The addendum language should say what success looks like (e.g., sustained p95 latency < 250ms for 24 hours under their test load + signed purchase order for minimum commit).
- Any regulatory or data residency concerns with the private sandbox? (we need this for legal/compliance signoff)

Suggested compromise to speed approval: approve 62.5k credits up front with a second tranche released at the day-45 review if they hit the milestones; extend sandbox 90 days but require an interim checkpoint and auto-expire if no activity for 30 days. If Edgewell agrees, we can route a short addendum to procurement and I’ll tag Laura for final sign-off.

Please reply with the consumption estimate and I’ll prepare the brief for Laura.

-Aditya
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request for CXO sign-off: temporary pilot uplift + 90-day sandbox extension

Team —

After reviewing the notes and the proposed compromise from Aditya I’m authorizing a limited exception with the following conditions:

1) Credits: approve a one-time 62,500 free token-credit tranche to be applied immediately. A second 62,500 tranche will be released only if Edgewell meets the day-45 success criteria (p95 latency < 250ms under their certified test load and a signed LOI indicating intent to purchase).

2) Sandbox: approve a 90-day private sandbox extension, effective from the sandbox activation date. The environment will be provisioned in the us-west region. Sandbox access will be revoked automatically if there is no activity for a continuous 30-day period.

3) Legal / Procurement: Dev, please circulate an addendum that includes the milestone criteria, LOI language, and a clause that requires Edgewell to provide a minimal SOC-2 attestation for the integration engineers who will access the private sandbox. Procurement must sign off before the second credit tranche is released. I’m copying the HubSpot ticket and the DocuSign envelope link below for tracking.

4) Finance: This is a one-time exception tied to DEAL-3892. If the customer converts, we will treat the credits as a pre-launch incentive and amortize per ARR conversion policy.

Dev — proceed with the 62.5k release and send the addendum to procurement + legal for final review. Get the LOI from Sanjay and schedule the day-45 review.

Laura Bennett
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
